title: 第23章 诡异生物第24章 拽什么拽
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
三人每天晚上把搜集到的信息聚拢到一起，由系统进行汇总分析，黄夜再一一讲解。
二女的江湖经验在快速提高，黄夜对城主府的情况也有了大致了解。
只是二人没有探听到任何关于他的信息，二女策略性问了一些老奴，他们都说不知道。
“今晚我出去看看外面的情况，顺便试试自己的实力，在府内没法试验。”
“祝少爷出去之后横扫一切！”
“哈哈，这话我爱听！”
入夜时分，一道黑影趁着夜色离开城主府，城主府五米高的围墙，黄夜毫不费力跳过去。
围墙外是一片密林，这一段是他特意挑好的地方，也是唯一一片没有民宅的区域。
看着一棵棵参天大树，还不错，先在这里试验自己的能力。
用足全力向上一跳，“嗖！”的一声，卧槽，怎么这么高。
这样落下去，会不会摔死。
没办法，坠下的同时不断薅住树枝，降低下坠速度。
双脚稳稳落地后感受一下，还可以，即使不减速，落下也应该没问题，只要多练习几次就能适应。
目测一下身边的大树，足有三十多米高。
卧槽，我是超人吧，现在这能力真不好意思再当灌篮高手。
没想到双修功法这么强大，这才短短一个月时间。
刚到这里的时候，自己才跳六米高，现在竟然翻了五倍，实力突飞猛进。
再试试力量，到了密林深处，到一棵大树旁站定。
一拳轰出，“嘭！”的一声，不仅整个拳头打进大树，连小臂都进去一半。
卧槽，这大树太脆弱了，抽出拳头，看了看拳面，一点破损都没有。

扒拉一下那个拳洞，呃，好像不是大树脆弱，而是这一拳力量太大，速度太快，所以打出个树洞。
还不错，这一拳怎么也有七八百斤吧，如果是碗口粗的小树，肯定轰断了。黄夜对力量的概念也不了解。
第一次打小院那棵树，只能把树皮打破，现在力量也能提高五倍。
满意地点点头，身形闪动几下，离开密林，绕过一片民宅，来到马路上。
道路两旁有不少店铺，这个时间，绝大部分店铺已经关门，路上只有寥寥无几的行人。
黄夜沿着马路悠哉悠哉走着，现在还不到深夜，有些店铺二楼有光亮传出，应该是商住两用的店铺。
看着店铺的招牌，还不错，卖什么的都有。
他现在是按图索骥，地图是晴儿出来订做夜行衣时顺便捎回去的。
现在这条马路是一条辅路，进入主路后的店铺更多。
据晴儿说，主路的一些店铺关门都比较晚。
到了闹市区，酒楼，茶楼和风月场所，关门的时间会更晚。
content_en:
The three people gathered the collected information together every night, and the system conducted summary analysis, and Huang Ye explained it one by one.
The two girls' martial arts experience was improving rapidly, and Huang Ye also had a general understanding of the situation in the City Lord's Mansion.
But they didn't get any information about him. The two women strategically asked some old slaves, but they all said they didn't know.
"I'm going out tonight to see what's going on outside, and test my strength by the way. I can't test it in the house."
"I wish the young master to conquer everything after he goes out!"
"Haha, I love hearing this!"
At night, a black shadow left the City Lord's Mansion under the cover of darkness. Huang Ye jumped over the five-meter-high wall of the City Lord's Mansion without any effort.
Outside the wall is a dense forest. This section was specially chosen by him, and it is also the only area without residential buildings.
Looking at the towering trees, it's not bad. Let's test our abilities here first.
He jumped up with all his strength, and there was a "whoosh!" Damn it, why is it so high?
If you fall like this, will you fall to death?
There is no other way. While falling, I keep grabbing the branches to slow down the falling speed.
Feel it after your feet land firmly on the ground. It's okay. Even if you don't slow down, you should have no problem falling down. You can get used to it as long as you practice a few times.
A visual inspection of the big tree next to me shows that it is more than thirty meters high.
Damn it, I’m a superman, but now that I’m so capable I’m really embarrassed to be a slam dunk master.
I didn't expect that the dual cultivation technique was so powerful, and it only took a month.
When he first arrived here, he could only jump six meters high. Now he has jumped five times, and his strength has improved by leaps and bounds.
Trying his strength again, he reached the depths of the jungle and stood next to a big tree.
With a punch, there was a "Bang!" sound. Not only did the entire fist hit the tree, but half of the forearm was also inserted.
Damn it, this big tree is too fragile. I took out my fist and looked at the fist surface. There was no damage at all.
Pulling the punch hole, eh, it seems that the tree is not weak, but the punch was too powerful and too fast, so it made a hole in the tree.
Not bad. This punch must have weighed seven to eight hundred pounds. If it was a small tree as thick as a bowl, it would definitely be broken. Huang Ye didn't understand the concept of power either.
The first time he hit the tree in the courtyard, he could only break the bark, but now his strength can be increased five times.
He nodded with satisfaction, flashed a few times, left the dense forest, walked around a residential house, and came to the road.
There are many shops on both sides of the road. At this time, most of the shops are closed, and there are only a few pedestrians on the road.
Huang Ye walked leisurely along the road. It was not yet late at night, and there were lights coming from the second floors of some shops. They should be commercial and residential shops.
Looking at the signboard of the store, it looks pretty good and sells everything.
He was now searching for the map, which Qing'er brought back when he went out to order night clothes.
This road is now a side road, and there are more shops after entering the main road.
According to Qing'er, some shops on the main road close relatively late.
In downtown areas, restaurants, teahouses and romantic places will close later.
